verdicts.reason: Cited functions only initialize locks/waitqueues/pcp and memblock array; actual struct definitions for base/size/flags, spans, and zone arrays are not in the cited symbols.
Mostly accurate, except slab_state transitions UP from DOWN -> PARTIAL -> UP -> FULL during boot, not 'cycles down to full'.
online_pages takes an already-chosen zone (zone choice happens in zone_for_pfn_range) and add_memory_driver_managed is not cited for driver ranges.
Shrink and shutdown discard empty slabs and report remaining slabs; oom_init is an __init hook, but kmemleak_scan_thread is the kthread body, not the boot init hook (kmemleak_late_init).

overall: All four findings are PARTIAL: core mechanisms match general kernel behavior, but claims overstate or slightly misattribute struct definitions, state transition direction, and helper entry points relative to the specific symbols cited.
